_doc: Copy to edit/edl.json once the footage has been reviewed. Times are seconds. Paths are relative to the repo root. Every value here is a creative decision; tools/render.py executes it exactly.
title: المدينة المنوّرة
_master_size_doc: [2160, 3840] only when every chosen shot is vertical 4K (inventory: supports_2160x3840_master)

shots._speed_doc: 0.7-0.85 for gentle slow motion from >=50 fps sources; keep 1.0 for 24/25/30 fps sources
shots._retime_doc: auto | frames (real frames only) | blend (even cadence for non-integer steps) | mci (motion interpolation: inspect!)
shots._frame_doc: 9:16 window centre (0-1 of the display-oriented source), zoom >= 1; optional 'end' animates a sub-pixel push/pan
shots._transition_doc: INTO this shot: cut | dissolve {dur} | dip {dur} (through black); centred on the cut point

_typography_doc: styles: title (Amiri Bold), line / small (IBM Plex Sans Arabic Light). Keep text inside x 90-910, y 250-1480 (Instagram UI). Never use \fsp letter-spacing on Arabic.
